items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the prose 'The Sermon at Benares', and answer.

"The old woman listened to the girl's story and then took her hand. 'Bring me a cup of water,' she said, 'from a well that has never been dry.' The girl searched for days. Every village had a story of a summer when its well had failed. When she returned with empty hands, she was quiet. 'Every well runs dry sometimes,' she said. The old woman only smiled."

Answer the following:
(i) What did the old woman ask the girl to bring?
(ii) Why did the girl return with empty hands?  (a) She was robbed  (b) She lost her way  (c) Every village had a well that had once run dry  (d) She fell ill
(iii) Which story from First Flight does this passage resemble?  (a) "The Sermon at Benares"  (b) "Bholi"  (c) "The Proposal"  (d) "Mijbil the Otter"
(iv) Why did the old woman only smile?
items.answer: (i) A cup of water from a well that had never been dry. (ii) (c) Every village had a well that had once run dry (iii) (a) "The Sermon at Benares" (iv) The girl had understood the lesson herself, so nothing more needed to be said.
items.markingKey: (i) A cup of water from a well that had never been dry. (ii) (c) Every village had a well that had once run dry (iii) (a) "The Sermon at Benares" (iv) The girl had understood the lesson herself, so nothing more needed to be said. (1 mark each, 4 marks.)
